lesser_shade: When the Eclipse failed, some records tore apart instead of burning. A Lesser Shade is what is left of one — half a page, trying to remember what it was. It attacks, then hides, then attacks again. It no longer knows which is right.
bone_crawler: Crawlers moved into the stacks after the shelves collapsed. They feed on the old bindings and wear the bones of the fallen as armour. A Bone Crawler stays behind its plates for as long as it can and strikes only when the shell is thick enough.
dark_acolyte: The acolytes kept the archive's catalogue. This one still does. It watches you from behind its open book, writing down every move you make. Each ward it raises is stored, and every one of them goes into its next spell.
tomb_guardian: The door-wards were trained to stand between intruders and the sealed rooms. There is nothing left behind those doors to protect, but the Tomb Guardian still takes its post. It draws every attack towards itself, and when its shield breaks, it answers in kind.
void_knight: This knight was standing too close to the core when time folded. The fold cracked its armour and filled the cracks with a cold light. It no longer defends, only cuts. Wound it badly and the light turns red — that is when it is most dangerous.
boss_knight: The final guardian stands at the core door. It fights in phases — steel, then walls of stone, then magic that silences your hand — as if it already knows every card you will play. Its armour is scarred in places you have not been hurt. Yet.
